run_d360_image_publisher: run the ROS2 node to publish DIGIT360 camera images to image_raw and image_raw/compressed topics
create_camera_publisher_node: create a CameraPublisher ROS2 node that streams frames from a video device to ROS2 image topics
publish_compressed_camera_images: publish JPEG-compressed camera frames to the image_raw/compressed ROS2 topic using CvBridge
publish_raw_camera_images: publish raw camera frames to the image_raw ROS2 topic with passthrough encoding via CvBridge
review_camera_publisher_threading: review the CameraPublisher class threading model that reads frames in a background thread and publishes on demand
